scope: Corollary 3.6 (Barycentric configurations) of the manuscript “Uniform Bi-Holder Transport from Weak MTW” (preprints/Uniform-Bi-Holder-Transport-from-Weak-MTW-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 360 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1e1a412dff1dd263), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume weak MTW and the convexity of Gx established in Corollary 2.6. Fix µ ∈ (0, 1) and positive constants κ, L0. Suppose p = N X i=1 mipi, pi ∈ Gx, mi > 0, X i mi = 1, and for one index i there are D > 0, a unit vector e, and ti > 0 such that pi = p + tie, h := p · e > 0, h2 ≥ κD, |pi|2 − |p|2 ≤ L0D, mi ≥ µ. (3.37) Then σx(p) ≥ cσx(pi), (3.38) where c > 0 depends only on (M, g), µ, κ, L0.
